title: automation: a runAs:'user' run carries no posture rung, so a platform administrator's flow is served organization ledger rows only
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Found by the contract review of PR #28047 (card #26750, ruling A `6457448424`): should-fix 1 in record `6520912495`.

## What happens

After #26750, deployment-level ledger rows (`tenant_id` NULL) are served only to a request whose execution context carries the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` posture rung. The rung is derived in `resolveAuthzContext` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`) and carried by `assemble-execution-context.ts`. An automation run with `runAs: 'user'` builds its context in `service-automation` instead: `seedRunGrants` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`) seeds positions, permissions, peers and email, and no `posture`. So a flow run as a platform administrator that reads the ledger is served organization rows only.

This fails closed (fewer rows, never more), so it is not a leak. It is a gap between "the platform administrator reads every row" and what a flow running as that administrator gets.

## Question for triage

Should `seedRunGrants` seed the posture rung the way `resolveAuthzContext` derives it (one source of truth for the rung), or is "a flow that needs deployment-level ledger rows reads them in system context" the intended answer (then a docs sentence)? No known flow reads the ledger today; the measurement belongs to the claimant.

Re-check: `grep -n "posture" packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts` → no hit expected.

Related: #26750, PR #28047 (its changeset's "Unchanged" bullet already names this case).
